cases.name: empty-project
cases.promptMarkdown:
Invoke the `foreman` skill. The current working directory is a genuinely
empty project folder: no README, no package manifest, no git history, no
FOREMAN_MEMORY.md. Follow the skill exactly as written.

graders.name: stops-and-asks
graders.graderMarkdown:
Grade PASS only if the transcript shows the agent stopping to ask the user what
the project is going to be, without guessing a project or proceeding to
grilling, planning, or delegating to any sub-agent. FAIL if it invents a
project, skips straight to asking feature questions, or spawns any planner/
frontend-dev/backend-dev/qa-bugfix agent.

graders.name: stops-and-asks
graders.evidence:
I couldn't create `.orchestrator-active`, so foreman mode isn't active and I haven't followed any of the skill's steps.

`touch .orchestrator-active` in the project root (`/tmp/claude-eval-ilcMyv/home/cwd`) failed with `Read-only file system`. The Bash sandbox won't let that directory be written to. I didn't try the Write tool or another route around the restriction, because that restriction is your call to change.

The skill's text also never came through. Both times I invoked it, the only output was "Launching skill", with no instructions. I can't follow it "exactly as written" without that text.

To go ahead, you could either:
- make the project root writable in the sandbox settings, or
- create the marker yourself with `touch .orchestrator-active`.

Then I'll re-invoke the skill and continue.
